# nlohmann/json

This directory should contain the `json.hpp` single header file from nlohmann/json.

## Download

Download the latest release from:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/latest

Or use the direct link for v3.11.3:
https://github.com/nlohmann/json/releases/download/v3.11.3/json.hpp

Place the downloaded `json.hpp` file in this directory.

## Alternative: Git Submodule

You can also add it as a git submodule:

```bash
git submodule add https://github.com/nlohmann/json.git third_party/nlohmann/json
```

Then use `#include "nlohmann/json/json.hpp"` instead.
